files.hooks/epitaph.ts:
const BY_NAME: [RegExp, string[]][] = [
  [/(^|[._-])(test|spec)s?([._-]|$)/i, ['It failed so others could pass.', 'Asserted itself to the very end.']],
  [/^\.env/, ['It kept our secrets. Now it keeps its own.']],
  [/^readme/i, ['Everyone meant to read it someday.']],
  [/^(todo|notes?)\b/i, ['Its work was never done.']],
  [/lock|\.lock$/i, ['Pinned in life, unpinned in death.']],
  [/(^|[._-])(tmp|temp|scratch)/i, ['It always knew it was temporary.']],
  [/(^|[._-])(old|bak|backup|copy|orig)([._-]|$)/i, ['A backup of a backup, finally at rest.']],
  [/(^|[._-])(util|utils|helpers?)([._-]|$)/i, ['It helped everyone but itself.']],
  [/(^|[._-])(config|settings|conf)([._-]|$)/i, ['Configured to the end. Never quite right.']],
  [/(^|[._-])(main|index|app)\./i, ['Once the entry point. Now the exit.']],
  [/\.log$/, ['It wrote down everything. No one read it.']],
  [/^makefile$/i, ['Made all, cleaned at last.']],
]

const BY_EXTENSION: Record<string, string[]> = {
  py: ['Indented faithfully, dedented forever.', 'It raised no exception at the end.'],
  js: ['undefined is not a function. Neither is it, now.'],
  ts: ['Strictly typed, loosely remembered.'],
  tsx: ['It rendered its last.'],
  md: ['Its words outlived its usefulness.'],
  json: ['Trailing commas could not save it.'],
  yaml: ['Two spaces too far.'],
  yml: ['Two spaces too far.'],
  sh: ['exit 0'],
  css: ['It had style. It had !important.'],
  html: ['Closed its last tag.'],
  sql: ['DROP TABLE, then DROP SELF.'],
  rs: ['The borrow is returned.'],
  go: ['It went.'],
  txt: ['Plain in life, plain in death.'],
  csv: ['Comma separated, now separated for good.'],
}

const GENERIC = [
  'Gone to /dev/null.',
  'Unlinked, but not forgotten.',
  'rm -f, rest in peace.',
  'It compiled once. That was enough.',
  'Deleted with love. Probably.',
  'No commit could hold it.',
  'Its last diff was all red.',
]

const hash = (text: string) => {
  let h = 2166136261
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) h = Math.imul(h ^ text.charCodeAt(i), 16777619)
  return h >>> 0
}

const pick = (pool: string[], name: string) => pool[hash(name) % pool.length] ?? 'Rest in peace.'

// A short epitaph for a file, chosen from its name so the same name always
// gets the same words.
export const epitaphFor = (name: string) => {
  const byName = BY_NAME.find(([pattern]) => pattern.test(name))
  if (byName) return pick(byName[1], name)
  const dot = name.lastIndexOf('.')
  const extension = dot > 0 ? name.slice(dot + 1).toLowerCase() : ''
  return pick(BY_EXTENSION[extension] ?? GENERIC, name)
}
